reviews.review_msg: Eugene is an engaging lecturer who is passionate about his work, and that translates into his teaching. It was a pleasure being in his class. GEGOG362W was the best class I have ever taken, and I recommend taking it if you have the chance!

Eugene is my FAVORITE prof at SFU, and this was my favorite class I've taken!!! He is such a kind professor who genuinely wants his students to do well. His lectures and assignments were so interesting; he really put a lot of thought into this course. Highly recommended taking a course with him.

This course is intense, demanding, and will definitely provide a reality check if you're not on your game. The upside is that your work habits will improve.  Prof's teaching style is authoritarian but he's also fair. Don't be late and don't eat in class. If you respect his rules and do the readings you'll be fine.
